title: Two-block splicing of finite alternating ordinal strings
statement:
Use standard simplices and their monotone-map coordinates from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. The inclusions of the two blocks of vertices $\Delta^m\to\Delta^{m+n}$ and $\Delta^n\to\Delta^{m+n}$ are induced by $i\mapsto i$ and $i\mapsto m+i$, respectively. The following gives the bijection on alternating strings for these two inclusions. For $r\geq0$ and $p,q\in\{-,+\}$, let $W_r(p,q)$ be the set of nonempty finite strings $(a_0,\ldots,a_w)$ in $\{0,1,\ldots,r+1\}$ with $a_0=p_r$, $a_w=q_r$, where $-_r=0$ and $+_r=r+1$. If $p=-$, require $a_i<a_{i+1}$ for even $i$ and $a_i>a_{i+1}$ for odd $i$; reverse these inequalities if $p=+$. Singleton strings are allowed. For any finite integer string $b$, define $R(b)$ by repeatedly deleting the leftmost adjacent equal pair until no adjacent equal letters remain. This is a deterministic finite algorithm and its value may be the empty string.

For $m,n\geq1$, define maps on integer alphabets
$$L(j)=\min(j,m+1),\quad U(j)=\max(j-m,0)\qquad(0\leq j\leq m+n+1).$$
On $\{0,\ldots,m+1\}$ put $v(j)=0$ for $j\leq m$ and $v(m+1)=1$. On $\{0,\ldots,n+1\}$ put $t(0)=0$ and $t(j)=1$ for $j>0$. Write $f_*a$ for entrywise application of an alphabet map $f$.

For each $p,q$, the assignment
$$c\longmapsto\big(R(L_*c),R(U_*c)\big)$$
is a bijection from $W_{m+n}(p,q)$ to
$$\{(a,b)\in W_m(p,q)\times W_n(p,q):R(v_*a)=R(t_*b)\}.$$
In particular both reduced block restrictions are nonempty and satisfy the indicated strict alternation. No bound on string length and no requirement to use all internal letters is imposed.

source.place: Riehl--Verity, Homotopy coherent adjunctions and the formal theory of monads, Proposition 3.2.2 and its proof, pp. 824--825; Definitions 3.1.2 and 3.1.8. The block restriction maps are the interval representations of {0,...,m} and {m,...,m+n}. Online paper read; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this finite-string splicing lemma.
